author: Czco
body:
IGN:  Czco

Discord( Name#):  
Coco♡
#4527

Timezone: BST/GMT

Why would you like to join the referee team(brief paragraph):

Id like to join the referee team as I feel I have enough experience and to be eligible for the position, I love the tournaments; the attitude, the feelings and the atmosphere, its great and to be a part of, and if i could help out with this it would be amazing. As you may know i was recently accepted to the Social media team i feel this has developed my skill in a team and really helped with my communication skills.

Best time of the week?:

I am active all the time on everyday form 4 two 10/10:30, I am on more on weekends and on tournament days i can be on from all times that are appropriate. 


A paragraph or two to tell us something about yourself(Pretend you are trying to sell yourself to us):

 I am a kid that loves to get involved no matter what it is, either a team or alone up to what i have been told to do, in no mean to be modest i just feel as if i am ready for this role and that i can really help out the team.

Anything else?:

As i mentioned before, when i was accepted to the social media team i was proud of myself, this made me to get more work done and have a better work ethic i really do feel i can bring my activity and my skill to the Ref team and work up the avicus rankings!
